observations: Photos show a vintage/industrial-looking sewing machine mounted on a wooden cabinet table with metal legs and a foot pedal setup.
The machine head has a brand plate that appears to read 'Hercules' (not fully clear).
There is a handwheel on the right side of the machine head and a second control/knob area on the front.
The table has a built-in metal base/stand and a lower metal grid shelf.
No close-up photo shows the model number/serial number, stitch settings, or the motor/power connection details.
Seller text says 'In a perfect condition' but photos do not confirm operation/testing.

read_from: photo 1 (brand plate on machine head appears to say 'Hercules')

claims.evidence: No photo shows it running, stitching, or any functional test; only exterior condition is visible.

risks.risk: Whether the machine is fully functional (needle timing, feed mechanism, tension, and motor/drive if any). Photos cannot confirm operation.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine running and stitching a fabric sample (showing feed moving and thread tension working).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/untested (worst case: may need service/repairs).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (bobbin case, presser feet, needles, power cable, foot pedal condition). Photos may not show all included items.
risks.proof: A photo checklist laid out on a table: bobbins, bobbin case, presser feet, needle(s), power cable, foot pedal, and any included manuals/tools.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as machine only (worst case: missing key accessories).

risks.risk: Model/serial mismatch or unknown exact variant affecting value and parts availability.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the model plate/serial number label on the machine head or underside of the cabinet.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the generic value for a used cabinet industrial sewing machine without confirmed model.

risks.risk: Condition issues not obvious from distance (rust inside, worn gears, bent needle bar, damaged belt/drive components).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area, feed dogs, bobbin area, and any belt/drive components (plus a quick run video).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing cleaning/maintenance (worst case: wear/rust).

proof_requests: Video of it running and stitching (fabric + thread visible) for at least 30–60 seconds.
Close-up photos of the bobbin area and feed mechanism (feed dogs moving).
Close-up of the model/serial number plate (clear text).
Photos of included accessories: needles, bobbins, presser feet, power cable, and foot pedal.
response.reason: The photos show a cabinet/table industrial sewing machine (brand plate appears to be 'Hercules'), but there’s no proof it works or what exact model/parts are included. To price safely, you need a stitching/running video and clear model/serial details.
